requirement: run invokes avl_runner.run exactly once per call
rationale: All cases are batched into one AVL invocation; multiple calls would spawn redundant processes

requirement: run passes the .avl file's parent directory as cwd
rationale: The LOAD command uses a bare filename; cwd=avl_dir ensures it resolves and that relative paths inside the .avl (airfoil data) also resolve

requirement: run creates a timestamped subdirectory {avl_stem}_{timestamp} inside out_dir
rationale: Fresh directory per run ensures previous results are never overwritten
Name encodes the geometry and time so multiple runs on the same geometry are distinguishable

requirement: run raises RuntimeError with the exit code when AVL exits non-zero
rationale: AVL can produce partial output before failing; raising prevents the caller from silently using corrupt results

requirement: stdin LOAD command uses the bare geometry filename (not a full path)
rationale: cwd=avl_dir means bare filename resolves correctly and stays under AVL's ~80-char Fortran string limit

requirement: Generated command script contains A A <alpha> for each requested alpha
rationale: Alpha values must reach AVL unchanged; silent truncation or formatting errors would run the wrong flight condition

requirement: out_dir is required; omitting it raises TypeError with message out_dir is required
rationale: An explicit out_dir forces the caller to choose where results land; no implicit write to cwd
Common interchange format for spreadsheets and downstream tools
Common interchange format for web tools and other language consumers

requirement: out_format=df returns results in memory without writing any file
rationale: Avoids unnecessary disk I/O in programmatic usage

requirement: out_format=<unrecognised> raises ValueError with message containing not recognised
rationale: Fails fast with a clear error rather than silently writing nothing

requirement: Single-point integration run returns at least one StResult with Alpha and CLtot fields
rationale: Smoke test confirming the full AVL binary pipeline produces parseable stability output

requirement: A 180-case bd sweep (5 alpha × 3 beta × 12 ctrl points at 5° steps) completes within 250 ms/case
rationale: Baseline throughput measured at 107 ms/case on a 2025 MacBook; 250 ms/case gives 2× headroom for CI and prevents silent performance regressions

requirement: run writes sweep.log to the run directory containing the stdin script fed to AVL
rationale: Provides a human-readable on-disk record of exactly what was piped to AVL to produce the .st files in that directory
